name: ultra11y
description: RGAA 4.1.2 accessibility audits, the French State's standard, on a WCAG 2.2 AA core: automatic review before commit, push and pull request, plus dated, evidenced Markdown, HTML and per-page conformance reports. Never declares conforming what it has not verified.

interface.shortDescription: RGAA 4.1.2 / WCAG 2.2 AA review before you commit, push or open a PR.
interface.longDescription: Accessibility audits against RGAA 4.1.2, the French State's standard, on a WCAG 2.2 AA core: a dated conformance report, the 106-criterion grid, a backlog and tickets, and a review of exactly the code under change. A zero-dependency static engine, scored against the W3C ACT corpus, plus a browser scan and the agent's judgment on what a static pass cannot decide, counter-checked by check/verify gates. It never declares conforming what it has not verified.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review my staged changes for accessibility.
